name: print
evidence: support/devtools/api-introspector/introspector.js:985 calls bare print() and that call emitted the committed runtime-api.json
why: Installed by the interpreter, not by Movian, so es_create_env does not mention it and the C scanner cannot see it. Both macros take their default (defined) branch -- this tree sets no DUK_OPT_NO_BROWSER_LIKE or DUK_OPT_NO_FILE_IO -- and src/ecmascript/ never deletes a global builtin.

name: require
evidence: every module under res/ecmascript/modules/ and every shipping plugin calls it
why: Same as print: an interpreter builtin. Movian supplies only the resolver, Duktape.modSearch (ecmascript.c:436-439), never the function itself.
